decisions.reason: The archiving software has its own page and is closely tied to the firm's control technology know-how, so the firm can read early feedback and keep improving it.
It is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with Product A, so it may be merged away, but it builds on the same software knowledge base and is cheap to maintain.
The manhole door with railing is a mechanical product close to the firm's water engineering hardware expertise, it has its own page, and demand is driven by safety requirements.
The floating sludge extractor fits the firm's existing machinery for wastewater tanks, so it draws on knowledge the firm already holds, even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The control technology complements the firm's machines and software, and it is central to applying the firm's accumulated knowledge commercially.
